scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, closure, fire, or disaster
canceled or suspended emergency food distributions due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
notes: No new qualifying signal was identified within the bounded observation window.
Kauaʻi hurricane-recovery reporting showed emergency food distributions proceeding as scheduled rather than being canceled or suspended.
Maryland's September 30 magstripe EBT cutoff has immediate access consequences but the official notice predates this observation window, so it was excluded as not new.

A same-day secondary Maryland EBT article surfaced in search but its page fetch was blocked by the source host; the older official Prince George's County notice was accessible and corroborated the cutoff.
Older grocery-store disruptions, routine pantry listings, resource guides, donation-oriented material, routine program promotion, generic inflation content, and duplicates were excluded.
